rubric_draft.proposed_question_text: Will at least three of the five largest national economies by nominal GDP (IMF WEO, 2099 reference year) route a majority of retail and wholesale payment settlement volume through post-2030 greenfield governance stacks that bypass legacy bank-regulator clearing intermediaries, as measured on or before 2100-12-31 UTC?
rubric_draft.proposed_resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least three of the top-five 2099 economies publish regulator or central-bank audited statistics showing >50% of domestic payment settlement volume cleared via greenfield protocols (defined as stacks launched after 2030-01-01 without legacy correspondent-bank rails as primary path) through 2100-12-31. FALSE if fewer than three meet the threshold by deadline. VOID if fewer than two top-five economies publish comparable settlement-rail definitions by 2101-03-31 or IMF discontinues comparable GDP ranking.

rubric_draft.proposed_question_text: Will at least one OECD member health ministry or equivalent national health authority publicly classify aging-related mortality as an engineering defect class with a published remediation SLO target date, and maintain that classification continuously from first publication through 2100-12-31 UTC?
rubric_draft.proposed_resolution_criteria: TRUE if an OECD-scale authority publishes an official document labeling aging-related mortality as an engineering or systems defect with a dated remediation SLO, and no subsequent official retraction occurs before 2100-12-31. FALSE if no such publication exists or all such classifications are officially retracted before 2100-12-31. VOID if OECD membership structure changes such that no comparable authority exists, or defect-class terminology cannot be verified from primary sources by 2101-03-31.

rubric_draft.proposed_question_text: Will fewer than 25% of humans with recognized legal personhood in the five most populous UN member states rely on non-biological primary cognitive substrate (whole-brain emulation, substrate upload, or equivalent) as their primary legal identity substrate, as officially reported on or before 2100-12-31 UTC?
rubric_draft.proposed_resolution_criteria: TRUE if aggregated official census or civil-registry statistics from the five most populous states show <25% of legally recognized persons using non-biological primary cognitive substrate through 2100-12-31. FALSE if >=25% in aggregate. VOID if fewer than three of the five publish substrate-classification statistics with comparable definitions by 2101-03-31.

rubric_draft.proposed_question_text: Will humanity's verified planetary primary energy harness remain below 10^17 watts (order-of-magnitude Kardashev Type I threshold) according to at least two independent global energy balance assessments, as of 2100-12-31 UTC?
rubric_draft.proposed_resolution_criteria: TRUE if at least two independent assessments (e.g. IEA successor, peer-reviewed planetary energy budget consortium) report primary energy harness <10^17 W through 2100-12-31. FALSE if two or more independent assessments report >=10^17 W sustained for at least one calendar year ending on or before 2100-12-31. VOID if no two independent assessments publish comparable planetary primary-energy totals by 2101-03-31.
